entries.13115c10231a10be: The company is promoting its 10-year medium- to long-term management plan, 'Shared Value Creation Strategy TOTO WILL2030,' and sets out as its desired state for 2030 'realizing clean, comfortable and healthy living' and 'contributing to society and the global environment.' It identifies its material issues (materiality) as 'Cleanliness, Comfort and Health,' 'Environment' and 'Connections with People,' and states that it will address them through two business axes: the 'Global Housing Equipment Business' and the 'New Domain Business.'
entries.1f3e7bbfa8f053cc: It is a business that manufactures and sells housing equipment in mainland China (revenue from external customers of ¥53,863 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026). It operates under the regional headquarters TOTO (China) Co., Ltd., and is shifting its business structure from a focus on new construction to a focus on remodeling.

entries.9c8b7f7108312f01: This is a business that manufactures and sells housing equipment in Asia and Oceania excluding mainland China (sales to external customers of ¥54,914 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026). Under the regional headquarters TOTO Asia Oceania Pte.Ltd., it operates in Taiwan, Vietnam, India and elsewhere, and in September 2025 it established a local subsidiary in Saudi Arabia.
entries.a00f93410c9063ba: The company has a structure in which the group manufactures a wide range of water-related products, including sanitary ware, warm-water washing toilet seats, faucet fittings, unit bathrooms, system kitchens and washstands, with domestic manufacturing subsidiaries each responsible for specific products and supplying them to the company. Within the group there are also subsidiaries that provide after-sales services, such as product repairs.
